title: Party pages: Press any button is a footer hint, the logo is smaller
why: Critic on 46, 55, 56 and 64 (3 of 5 each): Press any button is an instruction drawn as a filled button, a fake action; the 56px wordmark out-shouts the page title; the empty board line is the one message that matters and it is dim; the ring has no words. The prompt is a footer hint with a button glyph and accent words, the wordmark the 32px logo, the empty line light, the ring labelled. Restyle only.
now: The party pages show Press any button as a hint in the card footer.

edits.replacement: if(ring){ k=document.createElement('i'); k.className='aprg'; cell.appendChild(k); k=document.createElement('span'); k.className='aprt'; k.textContent='in the ring'; cell.appendChild(k); }
